problem_type: Design-lab stages render production canvas node cards outside their production host context, so global canvas CSS positions them against the page
symptom: Design Lab (macOS) on PR #1234 captured the shot-table cells with the table spilling past the card, the right-most column clipped and the footer 「已选 0 镜 · 读图模型 · 添加列」 missing; the user judged it a regression.
direct_cause: src/devlab/designLab/shotTable/ShotTableStage.tsx rendered ShotTableNode inside a static 960x420 div. Since 16a5b8fd5 (2026-10-08) other lab kits import styles/generationCanvas.css into the same design-lab bundle, whose `.generation-canvas-v2-node { position: absolute }` applies; production cancels it only under `.generation-canvas-react-flow` (generationCanvasReactFlow.css). The card became 1440x1000 positioned against the page and the footer landed at y=987, outside the 452px capture.
class_root: Each lab stage hand-builds its own host for production node cards; nothing gives them the production host context or checks that a captured card stays inside its cell, so a stage can silently capture a non-production layout and record it as a baseline.

invariant_owner_layer.why: LabCanvasNodeHost is the shared lab host that reproduces the React Flow node shell context; the visual spec rejects any captured cell whose node card is positioned against an element outside the cell.

affected_population: Every design-lab screen that renders a production canvas node card (shot-table, node-quick-actions, canvas-frame, canvas-grouping, version-cards, node-composer-bar, process-feedback, canvas-handles)
entry_points: Lab stages that mount production node components (ShotTableNode, BaseGenerationNode) directly
internal_only_reason: The invariant is between our own global canvas stylesheet and our own lab stages.
invariants: A production node card captured in a lab cell is positioned against an element inside that cell (production host context), never against the page

door_reduction.why_not: door-map.mjs does not scan src/devlab. LabCanvasNodeHost is the shared host (new), ShotTableStage is its first user, and the visual spec is the single read door every cell passes through; each owns a different part of the invariant.

generality_proof: The containment assertion runs for every non-viewport cell of every screen in the visual spec, so any present or future stage that hosts a card without production context fails before its screenshot is compared or recorded. A one-off scan of the first state of 11 node-rendering screens found only shot-table violating.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Gives lab cells the production React Flow host class and a sized positioning ancestor for node cards.
Rejects cells whose node cards escape the cell before capture.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Now wraps ShotTableNode in LabCanvasNodeHost; local run: card 960x420 inside the cell, footer at y=407; without the fix the new assertion fails both shot-table states.
Wraps the card in a sized relative div; DOM scan on 2026-10-18 found its node offsetParent inside the cell.

recurrence.reason: Any new lab screen that mounts a production node card without the host context reproduces this, and the CSS that triggers it is bundled whenever any lab kit imports the canvas stylesheet.
same_class_scan: grep -rlE 'BaseGenerationNode|ShotTableNode' src/devlab → 8 kits mount production node cards
In-page scan of 11 node-rendering screens (first state each) for absolute node cards whose offsetParent is outside the cell → only shot-table

prevention.invariant: No .generation-canvas-v2-node inside a captured cell is absolute/fixed with an offsetParent outside the cell.
prevention.failure_mode: The cell fails with a message naming LabCanvasNodeHost before the screenshot is compared or written.
prevention.strategy: Shared host component for the context plus a spec-level check every cell passes through.

legacy_paths.rationale: The bare div host is replaced in place; no parallel path remains.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls this invariant; it is between our own CSS / background writer and our own test fixtures.

migration: The shot-table pending registration added on 2026-10-18 is removed; its two baselines are re-recorded from CI (they also predate the #1171 vision-model selector in the footer).
residual_risks: The containment check only covers non-viewport captures; viewport captures (portal popovers) are not checked.
